name: Nanba Daisuke
source:
Kenta's companion, nicknamed Daichan.

Normally, he is gentle and strong. He is also popular with the girls for his fast-paced personality. In fact, he has an abnormal sexual appetite.

In the “Big Sis Hunters,” he is in charge of the heavy lifting.

If the sea weren't so salty, he could drink a lot of it.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=914256]getchu[/url]]
